# VRM1_Constraint_Twist_Sample

A VRM 1.0 sample model: a VRoid-style anime character with MToon materials, spring bones, roll and aim constraints, morph expressions and bone look-at.

## License settings

The model carries these in its `VRMC_vrm.meta`. Together with the VRM Public License 1.0 they are its license terms (VPL §1(h)).

| Setting | Value | Meaning for Sapphire |
|---|---|---|
| `avatarPermission` | `everyone` | Anyone may use it as an avatar. |
| `commercialUsage` | `corporation` | Commercial use, including by companies, is allowed. |
| `creditNotation` | `unnecessary` | Credit isn't required. |
| `allowRedistribution` | `true` | The file may be redistributed: committed to this public repository and shipped in builds. |
| `modification` | `allowModificationRedistribution` | Modified versions may be made and redistributed. |
| `allowExcessivelyViolentUsage` | `true` | |
| `allowExcessivelySexualUsage` | `true` | |
| `allowPoliticalOrReligiousUsage` | `true` | |
| `allowAntisocialOrHateUsage` | `false` | Images made with the model must not include antisocial or hate expressions (VPL §3(d)). |
